title: 1996 Cummins Swapped F(Z)J80
transmission: GM 4L80E automatic with TCI transmission controller
ai_summary: For-sale 1996 FJ80 (owner-labeled 'F4BT80') running a Cummins 3.9L 4BT with P7100 mechanical injection mated to a GM 4L80E automatic with an aftermarket TCI controller. Reported fuel economy of 18-21 mpg highway, 14-16 mpg city, and 13-14 mpg off-road, with extensive overlanding gear and documented maintenance.

complications.detail: 4L80E exhibits fickle lockup/overdrive behavior, requiring a manual torque-converter lockup switch or TCU reprogramming
Factory tachometer is disabled post-swap; a conversion module exists but was not installed
Minor oil leaks noted, addressed via upper/lower gasket replacement
